text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
She's here... She's gone... She's here...
She's
gone...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the day of Manhattan Cafe's debut,
and while
many of her peers are
trembling with nerves, her
mind is
elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Before the race... may I go and have a
look?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I found her... She was there...
Far beyond
the finish line...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She looked so happy. I knew I was right. So...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
choice_data_list_en: Let's close the gap, even just a bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their game of cat and mouse—long
played
without anyone knowing—finally
takes to the turf.
